2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-a-thread-summary and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give conversation_id (and app) and message_times: the times of the conversation's newest messages as the messages owner shows them (its newest page, like the last 100, is enough).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: thread-summary (records:read, records:list).
